fields.meta_title: Free Online Order Form Builder | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build an order form that adds up each order, takes card payment through Stripe and saves every order to a table you own. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build an Order Form That Turns Your Product List Into Orders
fields.hero_description: List what you sell and how buyers pay. Emergent builds the order form with a running total, takes payment at submit and saves each order to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What a Working Order Form Does
fields.features_subheading: Six pieces turn a product list into orders your team can pack and reconcile.
fields.feature_1:
Totals that add up as buyers type

Emergent lists each product with its price and a quantity box. The total updates with every change, and a delivery fee or minimum order applies before the buyer submits.
fields.feature_2:
Stock caps that hide sold-out items

Set a weekly limit for each item. Every order counts against that number, and the item leaves the form when it reaches zero. Nobody pays for a jar of jam you cannot ship.
fields.feature_3:
Card payment on the same page

Connect Stripe and buyers pay by card as they submit. Each order row shows the amount charged and whether it cleared. Reconciling the week takes one filter, not a stack of receipts.
fields.feature_4:
An orders table you own

Every order becomes a row with the buyer, the items, the total and the delivery date. Filter by date for tomorrow's packing list, or send the week to your bookkeeper as a CSV.
fields.feature_5:
Receipts for buyers, alerts for your team

Send each buyer an email receipt listing what they ordered and when it arrives. New orders post to a Slack channel or go to whoever packs them, with a link to the full order.
fields.feature_6:
Your domain and every line of code

Publish the order form on your own domain or embed it on your current site. Export the full source to GitHub when a developer wants to add customer accounts or inventory sync.

fields.usecase_heading: Order Forms for Four Kinds of Sellers
fields.tab_content_1:
Orders close Thursday at 6 pm for Saturday pickup

Hollow Creek Farm posts one link each Monday. Customers order eggs at $6 a dozen and a bread share at $9, then choose a pickup window at the Saturday market. Eggs are capped at 30 dozen and drop off the form once sold out. The packing list groups orders by pickup window.
fields.tab_content_2:
Every wreath counts toward a class total

Each student at Maple Grove Elementary gets a personal link to share with family. Parents order wreaths at $28 and candles at $14 and pay by card. The order is credited to the student and their class. The PTA watches class totals in one table, and delivery day starts from a list sorted by classroom.
fields.tab_content_3:
Once the buyer signs, finance starts the invoice

A sales rep at Northwind Analytics sets 40 seats at $45 per seat per month on a 12-month term. The buyer gets an order form tied to the master agreement, checks the $21,600 annual total and signs on screen. The signed copy goes to the contracts table, and finance gets an email to invoice from the start date.
fields.tab_content_4:
Prints picked by image number and size

After a family session, Rowan Studio sends the client a gallery with an order form under the last photo. The client types image numbers and picks a size for each: 8x10 at $25 or 11x14 at $40. Payment goes through Stripe. The paid order lands in the lab queue with each file name attached.

fields.howto_title: How to Create an Order Form
fields.howto_description: Decide what you sell and when orders close before you write the prompt.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Write down every product and price
fields.howto_step_1_des: Start with a list of what you sell: the name buyers know, the unit it comes in and the price. Note any size or flavor options next to each item. Every line on that list becomes a product with its own quantity box.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Picture the order from the packer's side. They need a name, a phone number and either a delivery address or a pickup time. Questions beyond that, like a birthday for marketing, belong on a later form or nowhere.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Decide when orders close for each delivery or pickup day, and cap anything you make in small batches. A cutoff two days before pickup leaves time to buy supplies and pull stock without guessing at demand.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Take card payment at submit through Stripe, or mark orders as pay on pickup for regulars you trust. Business buyers often expect an invoice instead. Give them that option along with a field for their billing contact.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Paste the product list and your rules into the prompt in plain English. Emergent builds the form with a running total and an orders table behind it. Ask for changes the same way, such as a new item or a later cutoff.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Decide who hears about each order
fields.howto_step_6_des: Pick where new orders go: a Slack channel for the kitchen, or an email to the person who ships. Each message links to the order row, and the packer works from that row instead of a retyped copy.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Place a test order end to end
fields.howto_step_7_des: Order two items as a customer, pay with a test card and read the receipt email. Then open the orders table and confirm the row matches what you bought. Refund the test charge before you share the link.

claims_to_source: An order form collects the information a business needs to take an order for its products or services
In B2B sales, an order form sets the products, quantities, price and term of a purchase and references the master agreement that governs it
In Word, a fillable form is built from content controls on the Developer tab, then protected with Restrict Editing so people can only fill in the fields
A purchase order comes from the buyer; a sales order comes from the seller to confirm and fulfill it
